stem: Which statement explains how the work of Dorothea Dix benefited U.S. society?

options.label: F
options.text: Mental-health facilities were opened to treat patients.

options.label: G
options.text: Doctors were required to get federal licenses to practice medicine.

options.label: H
options.text: States passed laws giving harsher sentences to criminals.

options.label: J
options.text: The government distributed land to poor people.
